rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term, especially for social networking as a general online or community activity.

example.english: Social networking makes it easy for people with common interests to stay in touch.
example.traditional: 社交網絡令志趣相投嘅人容易保持聯絡。
example.jyutping: se5 gaau1 mong5 lok6 ling6 zi3 ceoi3 soeng1 tau4 ge3 jan4 jung4 ji6 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok6

rows.note: Choose this when you want to stress interacting and communicating with people online rather than building personal contacts.

example.english: I mainly use social networking to communicate with fans of foreign bands.
example.traditional: 我平日主要靠網上社交同外國樂隊嘅歌迷交流。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 jat6 zyu2 jiu3 kaau3 mong5 soeng6 se5 gaau1 tung4 ngoi6 gwok3 ngok6 deoi2 ge3 go1 mai4 gaau1 lau4

rows.note: Use this for deliberate networking to develop career, business, sales, or customer contacts.

example.english: Ming goes to chamber of commerce gatherings for social networking and to meet more business partners.
example.traditional: 阿明去商會聚會，係為咗建立人脈，識多啲生意夥伴。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 heoi3 soeng1 wui2 zeoi6 wui6 hai6 wai6 zo2 gin3 laap6 jan4 mak6 sik1 do1 di1 saang1 ji3 fo2 bun6
